content.title: American Airlines, JetBlue Shares Are Dropping After Earnings
content.summary: American Airlines  stock slid early Tuesday as the carrier’s fourth-quarter earnings fell short of expectations but management provided upbeat guidance for 2026.  The carrier reported adjusted earnings per share of 16 cents from revenue of $14 billion.  Wall Street was looking for earnings of 37 cents per share, while revenue was in line with expectations.
